caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a dress, centered on a plain, neutral background. The dress features short sleeves and an empire waist, with the skirt portion falling to about ankle length. The main fabric of the dress is a pink and white plaid pattern, composed of alternating horizontal and vertical lines forming small squares. The bodice and skirt are gathered at the waist, which is accentuated by a narrow belt or band in the same plaid pattern. Two horizontal border bands of lighter material run near the hemline of the skirt. Underneath the dress, visible below the hem, is a pair of white undergarments or petticoats, finished with a row of lace trim at the bottom edge. The composition is simple, with the dress drawn in detailed coloration and pattern against a plain, unadorned background. At the bottom right of the image, the name "NANCY CRIM" is written in small letters.
